nodes.name: useSpotlightItems.ts
nodes.summary: Pure derivation hook that transforms spotlight state (repos, branches, search query, actions) into the ranked list of SpotlightItems shown in the command palette, composing action definitions, item builders, and domain adapters.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the workspace-related form hooks (add workspace flow, clone, create, and local workspace forms) and their option/return types.

nodes.name: useAddWorkspaceFlow.ts
nodes.summary: Consolidates the multi-stage 'add workspace' modal flow shared by the repo selector and session source selector, composing the clone/create/local workspace form hooks and driving modal stage transitions.

nodes.name: useCloneForm.ts
nodes.summary: Manages clone-repository form state, covering both 'pick from my GitHub' and 'paste a GitHub URL' workflows, including GitHub repo fetching/caching and default clone path resolution.

nodes.name: useCreateWorkspaceForm.ts
nodes.summary: Manages state for creating or editing a multi-repo workspace from the repo selector palette, persisting folder selections via the Tauri workspace API and activating the resulting workspace.

nodes.name: useWorkspaceForm.ts
nodes.summary: Manages local workspace creation and import form state, detecting whether a chosen directory is an existing Git repo versus a plain folder and routing to the appropriate import/create Tauri call.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file that re-exports the primary GlobalSpotlight hooks (provider, main composition hook, effects, add-workspace flow, recent paths, shared repo list, workspace switch, account footer, path segment) for consumption by palette components.

nodes.name: useSelector.ts
nodes.summary: Shared base hook providing common selector-palette state, open/close effects, focus management, and keyboard handling reused by every spotlight sub-palette.

nodes.name: useAccountFooterForHovered.tsx
nodes.summary: Given the currently hovered palette item and a resolver, decides whether to render a CLI-agent or API-provider account footer and returns the SpotlightAccountFooter node for that item.

nodes.name: usePathSegment.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves a PathConfig into the spotlight breadcrumb path-segment shape consumed by SelectorScaffold, translating i18n label/template keys and applying optional caller overrides.

nodes.name: useRepoGitStatus.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches git status (uncommitted files, ahead/behind counts) for multiple repositories via the shared MultiRepoGitStatusContext singleton.

nodes.name: useSpotlight.ts
nodes.summary: Main composition hook for the GlobalSpotlight command palette; orchestrates the reducer-based state, derived items, branch/repo data, action dispatch, and view-service side effects (panels, sidebar, workstation tabs).

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level GlobalSpotlight component that renders the modal shell and switches between the command palette and its various sub-palettes (workspace, branch, worktree, agent control, session search), wiring git/workspace actions to the Rust backend via gitApi.

nodes.name: navDestinationGroups.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the INTEGRATIONS, MARKET, and ACTIONS navigation destination groups for the spotlight registry, extracted from navDestinations.ts to keep that file under the line-count limit.

nodes.name: navDestinations.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for every URL destination the spotlight 'Navigate to a page' action can reach, deriving labels/icons from the path via the central path-icon registry.

nodes.name: navDestinationsSearch.ts
nodes.summary: Token-based ranked search over the Global Spotlight navigation destinations, tokenizing labels/descriptions/paths and scoring matches for the spotlight search mode.

nodes.name: navDestinationsTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Leaf type module defining NavDestination and NavDestinationGroup shapes shared by the navigation registry, groups, and search files without creating an import cycle.

nodes.name: useSpotlightItems
nodes.summary: Derives the full ranked list of SpotlightItems (view actions, theme actions, nav destinations, repos, branches, recent actions) from current spotlight state for the given search mode.

nodes.name: consumeDragDropInitialPath
nodes.summary: Reads and clears a drag-and-drop initiated workspace path stashed in sessionStorage, parsing its JSON payload for one-shot consumption.

nodes.name: useAddWorkspaceFlow
nodes.summary: Consolidated add-workspace modal flow hook that manages stage transitions and composes the local/clone/create workspace form hooks into shared menu items and handlers.

nodes.name: useCloneForm
nodes.summary: Implements the clone-repository form: fetches/groups the user's GitHub repos, filters them by search text, and executes the clone action for either the selected GitHub repo or a pasted URL.

nodes.name: useCreateWorkspaceForm
nodes.summary: Implements create/edit-workspace form state: builds folder records from selected repo ids and persists the workspace via the Tauri create/update workspace APIs.

nodes.name: useWorkspaceForm
nodes.summary: Implements the local-workspace create/import form: lets the user choose a directory, detects Git presence, and routes to importLocalRepo or importWorkFolder accordingly.

nodes.name: useSelector
nodes.summary: Shared selector-palette hook providing search query state, selection index, keyboard navigation, open/close focus effects, and item click handling reused across all spotlight sub-palettes.

nodes.name: useAccountFooterForHovered
nodes.summary: Resolves the hovered spotlight item via the supplied resolver into either a CLI-agent or API-provider account list and returns the corresponding SpotlightAccountFooter element.

nodes.name: usePathSegment
nodes.summary: Translates a PathConfig's i18n label/template into the breadcrumb path-segment array consumed by SelectorScaffold's `path` prop.

nodes.name: useRepoGitStatus
nodes.summary: Builds a repo-path-to-GitStatus map by reading from the shared MultiRepoGitStatusContext for a given set of repositories.

nodes.name: useSpotlight
nodes.summary: Main GlobalSpotlight orchestration hook combining reducer state, derived items, branch/repo data hooks, action dispatch/fallback handling, and view-service side effects for panels and workstation tabs.

nodes.name: getWorktreeCreateName
nodes.summary: Derives a slugified worktree branch name from a WorktreeLaunchSource, handling issue/PR-sourced and freeform name/branch cases.

nodes.name: GlobalSpotlightInner
nodes.summary: Internal implementation of the GlobalSpotlight modal: wires useSpotlight state to the shell UI, renders the active sub-palette (workspace/branch/worktree/agent-control/session-search), and handles git worktree/branch actions against gitApi.

nodes.name: GlobalSpotlight
nodes.summary: Public GlobalSpotlight wrapper component that supplies the SpotlightProvider context around GlobalSpotlightInner.

nodes.name: resolveIcon
nodes.summary: Resolves a navigation destination's icon from the central path-icon registry, honoring an optional override icon.

nodes.name: dest
nodes.summary: Factory helper that builds a single NavDestination entry (label, path, icon, description) for the INTEGRATIONS/MARKET/ACTIONS groups.

nodes.name: wizardDest
nodes.summary: Factory helper that builds a NavDestination entry pointing at a specific setup wizard path.

nodes.name: resolveIcon
nodes.summary: Resolves a navigation destination's icon from the central path-icon registry for entries defined directly in this file.

nodes.name: dest
nodes.summary: Factory helper that builds a single NavDestination entry for the PAGES/SETTINGS groups defined in this file.

nodes.name: describeNavDestination
nodes.summary: Produces the translated label and description string for a NavDestination, used by both breadcrumbs and spotlight search.

nodes.name: buildSearchCorpus
nodes.summary: Flattens a navigation destination plus its translated label/description into a token set used as the searchable corpus.

nodes.name: scoreDestination
nodes.summary: Scores how well a tokenized query matches a destination's search corpus, weighting exact/prefix token matches for ranking.

nodes.name: searchNavDestinations
nodes.summary: Public entry point that tokenizes a query, scores every NAV_DESTINATIONS entry, and returns them sorted by relevance for the spotlight search mode.
